name: open-llm-benchmark-subset
description: A curated Hugging Face subset drawn from the Open LLM Benchmark intended for quick evaluations of open-domain language models across a mix of standard NLP tasks. It aggregates multiple tasks/formats so users can run fast, comparable checks of model ability on common prompts and classification/generation items.
reputation: A small community-contributed Hugging Face dataset used for quick local evaluations but not a widely cited benchmark.
